description: Find the Internet Archive Wayback Machine snapshot of a URL closest to a given date (default: now): capture time, how many days off it is, the viewable snapshot URL, a raw-content URL (original bytes, no Wayback toolbar), HTTP status, MIME type and content digest, plus a few next-closest captures. Defaults to successful (HTTP 200) captures only. Uses the public CDX index with an availability-API fallback. Good for seeing what a page said on a past date or proving when content changed.

alternatives.description: How many next-closest captures to include, 0-10 (default 4)

date.description: Target date: ISO (2015-01-01 or 2015-01-01T12:00:00Z) or Wayback timestamp (20150101). Default now

url.description: Page or domain to look up, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/pricing

name: archived_page_lookup
